Messages.Author: Ron
Messages.Body:
Question about Secure Haven

Anson has a Secure Haven on him as well as The Rack and a
Haven Uncovered.

Another player wishes to 1.) Steal the Rack , directed
action, is it possible?
2.) Arson the
Secure Haven or Rack, is this?
3.) Use Haven
Uncovered to enter combat, same?

Some clarification would be greatly appreciated.

Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <3518147C...@total.net>, Ron <del...@total.net> wrote:
>Question about Secure Haven

whoa there, ron. best check yer tab settings -- you're wandering all over
the page here.

> Anson has a Secure Haven on him as well as The Rack and a
>Haven Uncovered.

say: "I take refuge in LSJ, who brings the light of truth to men."
and away we go.

>Another player wishes to 1.) Steal the Rack , directed
>action, is it possible?

Ayup. This (D) action targets the Methuselah, not Anson (an incidental
target of the Rack's effect).

>2.) Arson the
>Secure Haven or Rack, is this?

This (D) action targets the location, not the (incidental) vampire, so yeah.

>3.) Use Haven
>Uncovered to enter combat, same?

Nay -- This (D) action targets the vampire, much like Bum's Rush*.

gomi
*but only LSJ knows all
--
kono sora wo daite kagayaku,
shounen yo shinwa ni nare.

Since the Rack has the odd aspect of being targetted at a vampire vs.
being put on a vampire, does the Rack cost one pool to play on a secure
havened vampire?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
daniel frey wrote:
> Since the Rack has the odd aspect of being targetted at a vampire vs.
> being put on a vampire, does the Rack cost one pool to play on a secure
> havened vampire?

No. Similarly, you could play a contract on a minion and name an
Assamite who had a Secure Haven without paying a pool. (Although
you would have to pay a pool if the minion who you put the
Contract on has a Secure Haven, of course, not that it would
accomplish much, since you couldn't use it to attack the
minion until the Haven was burned.)
